notes: SDK mixable ClassElement and MixinElement contracts are deduplicated with SDK extension/implementation contracts and archived as sdk_mixins. Original analyzer enforces legal modifiers and application constraints.
SDK ancestor resolution accepts ClassDeclaration and MixinDeclaration. UnmodifiableMapView private SDK mixin ancestry is preserved without copying SDK bodies or state.

ListMixin/MapMixin aliases resolve to real SDK class identities. SDK sort and traversal call patched operators, and a patch-only MapMixin application stays alive through a native SDK values view across GC.

Direct public linked SDK extension/interface on-constraints support concrete super calls, generic map, abstract index reads/writes, abstract length, and a Comparable abstract method tear-off. The applying superclass supplies real implementations.

Only source-used abstract super selectors generate bridges, including members declared solely on an on-constraint interface. Abstract and noSuchMethod-based applications retain their original obligations.
First introduction of abstract super[] relinks Choosing and Chosen through the established class-version mechanism; Concrete and independent consumers main/consume remain baseline AOT.
The main mixin fixture replaces no baseline classes. Original AOT read/joined/ordered/total/churn/mapped/replace/count/comparer and business noSuchMethod stay retained.
All 15 fixture groups were rebuilt with the current compiler and checked against source archives, runtime provenance and artifact hashes. This is not the entire historical native suite.

Initial probe exposed the difference between superclass ancestry and interface-only ListBase requirements. Fixed bridge discovery is covered by both native fixtures. An unchanged-source exploratory patch was rejected for no function changes; the first targeted unittest command used a wrong Python module path and was rerun correctly. These failed attempts are preserved and not counted as passing.
